title: Berlin Marathon ballot *closes tomorrow*
hook: Last chance to enter the 2027 Berlin Marathon lottery.

slides.label: What happened
slides.c: The BMW Berlin Marathon lottery opened on 1 Oct and shuts on Thursday 12 Nov 2026. Entry is via the official site.

slides.label: Key dates
slides.c: Results are emailed on 3 Dec. Race day is Sunday 26 Sep 2027. Fee reportedly €215, charged from 4 Dec.

slides.label: How to enter
slides.c: Sign up on the official Berlin Marathon site. Time-qualifier entries use the same window. Closing time unconfirmed, so do not wait.

caption:
NEWS: Berlin Marathon 2027 ballot closes tomorrow

The BMW Berlin Marathon lottery for 2027 closes on Thursday 12 Nov 2026; results are emailed on 3 Dec (as of 11 Nov 2026).
Source: Marathon Handbook, The Running Channel
